title: Indian Association founded in Calcutta
detail: A public meeting established the Association. Its organizers included Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, Monomohun Ghose, Shivanath Sastri, and Dwarkanath Ganguli.

title: Civil Service examination campaign launched
detail: At a public meeting, the Association called for raising the maximum examination age from 19 to 22 and holding examinations in India as well as London.

title: Banerjea tours India to organize support
detail: As the Association’s delegate, Banerjea organized Civil Service campaign meetings across northern India, then continued to Bombay, Surat, Ahmedabad, Poona, and Madras.

title: Calcutta meeting protests the Vernacular Press Act
detail: The Association held a public protest meeting at Calcutta Town Hall; Bagal reports attendance of about five thousand and records the meeting’s resolutions against the Act.
